_note: Default config of StuppFKPPSolver: every parameter, the optional ones at the class defaults except the time step (tests/test_config.py checks that). Volumes are NIfTI paths relative to this file; the tissue maps are the reference_solves/ maps (182x218x182, 1 mm). The dynamics, the treatment parameters and resection_time are the medians of the sensitivity search space fisher_kpp_jax/search_spaces/stupp_fkpp_search_space.json (2026-09-10; the geometric centre of a log-uniform range, the midpoint of a uniform one): white_matter_diffusivity and rho from a front speed of 0.0866 mm/day and a front width of 2.236 mm (D = v lambda / 2, rho = v / (2 lambda)), chemo_kill_rate 5.477e-4, rt_alpha 0.04472, resection_time 115 days. The entries with class defaults stay at them (rt_alpha_beta_ratio 10 where the search space's median is 8; the seed's mass 1500 and diffusion time 15, a peak of 0.58 at sigma 5.5 mm, where the search space's median seed is a peak of 0.8 at sigma 6.3 mm), since tests/test_config.py pins them to the class defaults; the seed is the image center.
_time_step: steps_per_day 12 (dt = 1/12 day) instead of the class default null: null leaves the step to the solver's stability estimate, max(8 D T / dx^2 + 100, 1.1 rho T) steps over the horizon T, whose step grows with T and exceeds one day for slow tumors (14 % of the 2026-09-07 sensitivity sweep, whose runs all used this config). The solver still raises the step count to its estimate where that is stricter (fast diffusion), with a warning; at most one of n_steps, dt and steps_per_day may be set. scripts/sensitivity_analysis.py refuses a base config with all three null.
_volumes: resection_cavity ({"segmentation": <NIfTI path>, "label": <int>}) and rt_dose (Gy, TOTAL over all fractions) are null: no example segmentation and dose map ship with the repository yet, so this config does not run until they are given.
_clock: Times are days: t=0 is the tumor seed, the simulated growth before surgery is resection_time, the total simulated time is resection_time + time_after_resection.
_schedule: seed (day 0) --> resection (day 115) --> recovery (days 115-129) --> radiotherapy: 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks (days 129-168, Monday = day 129); concomitant TMZ 75 mg/m^2 daily INCLUDING weekends over the same 6 weeks (days 129-170, 42 sessions) --> 4-week break --> adjuvant TMZ on days 1-5 of six 28-day cycles starting 4 weeks after the last fraction (day 196): days 196-200, 224-228, 252-256, 280-284, 308-312, 336-340; 150 mg/m^2 in cycle 1, 200 mg/m^2 in cycles 2-6 (72 sessions in total) --> growth to day 375 (35 days after the last dose). Every event is stated relative to the resection at day 115 (the sensitivity analysis shifts the schedule with its sampled resection_time and truncates it to its horizon).
_treatment: chemo_kill_rate (1/day per mg/m^2; 5.477e-4 is the geometric centre of the sensitivity search space's range 1e-4-3e-3, a total log kill of 0.53 over the full schedule at chemo_decay_rate 9.24, 0.29 over the sensitivity analysis's truncated schedule), chemo_decay_rate (1/day; 9.24 is temozolomide's ~1.8 h plasma half-life, Baker et al. 1999, Clin Cancer Res 5:309) and rt_alpha (1/Gy; 0.04472 is the geometric centre of the search space's range 0.01-0.2) are PLACEHOLDERS awaiting review. rt_alpha_beta_ratio is the linear-quadratic alpha/beta ratio in Gy (rt_beta = rt_alpha / rt_alpha_beta_ratio in 1/Gy^2 is derived by the solver and is not a config entry); 10 Gy is the class default.
